rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a message transmitted by telegraph.

example.english: I received a telegram yesterday notifying me that my flight was delayed.
example.traditional: 我琴日收到一封電報，通知我班機延誤。
example.jyutping: ngo5 kam4 jat6 sau1 dou2 jat1 fung1 din6 bou3 tung1 zi1 ngo5 baan1 gei1 jin4 ng6
